(arXiv:2102.03431) characterizes CFN sunlet quadrics (quadratic in sunlet ideal iff in both displayed-tree ideals) and conjectures generation, but never compares a triangle network against the 4-sunlet and never evaluates this f0 pairing. (arXiv:2607.12919) Lemmas 4.3/4.5/4.6 and Theorem 4.9 prove full identifiability on Theta0 for JC/K2P/K3P: Lemma 4.6 shows Q_{12|34} vanishes on split-12|34 quarnets (with a CFN-embedding remark as a proof device) but its non-vanishing argument explicitly excludes the 4-sunlet topology (deferred to Lemma 4.5 topology separation on Theta0 restricted images, which does not imply CFN ideal inequality). Gross-Krone-Martin dimensions are triangle-free only. The Pfaffian paper (arXiv:2312.07450) describes an affine CFN sunlet patch, not a triangle-versus-sunlet ideal comparison. No database row (OscarDB/MathRepo/Macaulay2 docs/tutorials) certifies this CFN pair. The synthesis of a triangle-side factorization with a sunlet-side stochastic non-vanishing witness is a new cross-skeleton boundary fact, not a mechanical single-source corollary, renaming, or recomputation.
